label: All Souls College MS 288

metadata.label: Hand
metadata.value: Nastaʿlīq script in the main text and marginalia. Multiple hands in marginalia. Post-colophon by a later hand.

metadata.label: Dimensions
metadata.value: 35 × 33.3 × 5 cm (size of binding). 35 × 23.5 cm (size of leaf).

metadata.label: Decoration
metadata.value: Golden ink for chapter headings and other titles. Illustrations.

metadata.label: Binding
metadata.value: Leather binding, gilded and tooled. One central medallion with two vertical lockets and two horizontal lockets, and fore-edges decorated with corner patterns.

metadata.label: Origin Note
metadata.value: According to a colophon appearing at the end of the manuscript, the manuscript was completed on 26 Ṣafar 988 AH, which is 22 April 1580 CE (or 12 April 1580 of the Julian calendar).

metadata.label: Record Origin
metadata.value: Description provided by Dr. Pranav Prakash.

metadata.label: Holding Institution
metadata.value: All Souls College, University of Oxford
